summary:
Main
On May 7, 2026, the iron ore market showed a volatile but strengthening trend with intense trading activity.The main contract I2609 finally closed at 817 yuan/ton, up 0.62% from the previous trading session. Port spot prices remained largely unchanged from the previous day. Traders showed moderate quoting activity, while steel mills were cautious in their purchases; overall spot market transaction sentiment was average.
